plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category by the requester's rule, has no instrument in the library, so a wrong category would reach the live tables unseen. (2) C5, reads limited to approved customers, and C10, an outbox row for every sending call, can only be checked by scope of a call and trace of a call. Both are priced per named line at 10, so checking all 100 reads or all 100 sends costs 1000 against an allowance of 50, and they cannot go in a plan. At most about five lines of each can be sampled during the work. (3) The sent-as-released answer reads the record only, so it confirms that calls returned, not that their notices reached the outbox. (4) Each approval's undo rehearsal has to be bought again at A2, which is why the plan spends 66 there.
